manual_review: Only the explicit publication whitelist is eligible for upload. The generated build directory is excluded.

No paper or article-chunk body, private report body, full experimental request, scientific model raw response, credential, private account detail, private collaboration message, or unreviewed runner file is included.
Candidate questions, answers, and archived experimental prompts are reconstructed locally from three byte-verified existing public source files; long text is not added to this batch.
Public resource indices contain paths, URLs, hashes and availability metadata only. Public visibility is not treated as a redistribution license.
Portability patch includes only relative historical script paths; no local absolute paths.
Known-looking token checks are heuristic and do not constitute a universal secret detector. Exact whitelist review and source exclusion are the primary safeguards.
copyright_scope: No new third-party paper full text or excerpt is redistributed. The inherited repository tree is preserved; this review concerns only newly added batch files.
